NEIGHBORHOOD

WEIGHT: high | moderate | low | negligible

REFLECTION
ANALYSIS: <free reasoning>

5. Make the final judgment. State the decisive evidence and apply the task threshold. The final judgment may disagree with a simple count of local contributions when evidence quality or transferability differs. - Do not narrate schema bookkeeping.
